description: The four plots in Figure 4.1 share the same x-axis and y-axis, with the x-axis labeled "epoch" and having a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1, and the y-axis labeled "WER" with a linear scale. The top-right plot has a y-axis range of 20 to 60, the bottom-left plot has a y-axis range of 25 to 42.5, the bottom-right plot has a y-axis range of 10 to 30, and the top-left plot has a y-axis range of 15 to 35. The top-right plot illustrates the WER during fine-tuning the Whisper model for the "base" type, with four lines representing different configurations: "base AdaLoRA_int4" (blue, diamond marker, solid line) starting at 60 and decreasing to 26, "base AdaLoRA_int8" (blue, square marker, solid line) starting at 58 and decreasing to 25, "base int4" (blue, diamond marker, dashed line) starting at 58 and decreasing to 28, and "base full" (blue, triangle marker, dashed line) starting at 57 and decreasing to 30, all showing a declining trend across the epochs. The bottom-left plot shows the WER for the "small" type, with four lines: "small AdaLoRA_int4" (orange, diamond marker, solid line) starting at 30 and decreasing to 26.5, "small AdaLoRA_int8" (orange, square marker, solid line) starting at 30.5 and decreasing to 27, "small int4" (orange, diamond marker, dashed line) starting at 35 and peaking at 41 at epoch 2 before decreasing to 32, and "small int8" (orange, square marker, dashed line) starting at 32 and decreasing to 29, with varying trends across the epochs. The top-left plot represents the WER for the "medium" type, with four lines: "medium AdaLoRA_int4" (green, diamond marker, solid line) starting at 28 and decreasing to 12, "medium AdaLoRA_int8" (green, square marker, solid line) starting at 28 and decreasing to 13, "medium int4" (green, diamond marker, dashed line) starting at 30 and decreasing to 16, and "medium int8" (green, square marker, dashed line) starting at 30 and decreasing to 16, all showing a declining trend. The bottom-right plot illustrates the WER for the "large" type, with four lines: "large AdaLoRA_int4" (purple, diamond marker, solid line) starting at 20 and decreasing to 11, "large AdaLoRA_int8" (purple, square marker, solid line) starting at 20 and decreasing to 11, "large int4" (purple, diamond marker, dashed line) starting at 25 and decreasing to 14, and "large int8" (purple, square marker, dashed line) starting at 23 and decreasing to 14, with all lines showing a declining trend across the epochs.
